mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP indicates a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where GDP growth exceeds 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where the federal funds rate exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where the unemployment rate is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where industrial production growth exceeds 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth and low unemployment rates indicates a growing economy with high consumer confidence, leading to increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDP growth exceeds 2% YoY and the unemployment rate is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate and an increase in housing starts indicate an easing monetary cycle and increased consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decline > 0.5% in 3 months and HOUST growth > 5% YoY
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where the federal funds rate declines by more than 0.5% in 3 months and housing starts growth exceeds 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment rates and strong payroll growth indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where the unemployment rate is below 4.5% and payroll growth exceeds 1.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales and an increase in consumer price index indicate decreased consumer spending and high inflation, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decline > 1% in 3 months and CPIAUCSL growth > 3% YoY
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where retail sales decline by more than 1% in 3 months and the consumer price index growth exceeds 3% YoY.
